claims.text: What the image looks like Apical ballooning post-emotional stress, EF recovers → Takotsubo (stress) cardiomyopathy
claims.quote: Apical ballooning post-emotional stress, EF recovers Takotsubo (stress) cardiomyopathy

claims.text: Echo (PLAX views): midsegment and apical dyskinesia resembling the takotsubo pot
claims.quote: Echocardiography in TCM: PLAX views demonstrating midsegment and apical dyskinesia resembling the takotsubo pot.

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Regional wall motion: 17-segment model; akinesis/hypokinesis suggests prior MI in a coronary distribution
claims.quote: Regional wall motion - 17-segment model; akinesis/hypokinesis suggests prior MI in coronary distribution.

claims.text: Mayo criteria: transient dyskinesis of the LV apical and/or midsegments; wall motion abnormalities beyond a single epicardial vascular distribution; no coronary stenosis > 50% of culprit lesion; new ECG changes (ST elevation or T wave inversion) or moderate troponin rise; no phaeochromocytoma or myocarditis
claims.quote: Mayo Clinic diagnostic criteria Transient dyskinesis of the LV apical and/or midsegments Regional wall motional abnormalities beyond a single epicardial vascular distribution Absence of coronary artery stenosis > 50% of culprit lesion New ECG changes (ST elevation or T wave inversion) or moderate troponin rise Absence of phaeochromocytoma and myocarditis

claims.text: Often mimics a STEMI; angiography is required to definitively differentiate the two
claims.quote: The presentation often mimics a STEMI and angiography is required to definitively differentiate the two conditions

claims.text: Causes A transient LV apical wall motion abnormality associated with severe emotional or physical stress that usually resolves completely
claims.quote: Transient wall motion abnormality of the left ventricular apex associated with severe emotional or physical stress that usually resolves completely

claims.text: Thought to be: acute stress → catecholamine surge → sympathetic activation → microvascular spasm; the apex's highest density of sympathetic fibres may explain the regional dyskinesia; at least one-third have a degree of LVOT obstruction (usually more severe disease and poorer prognosis)
claims.quote: Pathophysiology is thought to be related to a combination of sympathetic nervous system activation, microvascular spasm, and underlying LVOT obstruction: An acute stress response leads to a catecholamine surge Ensuing sympathetic nervous system activation causes microvascular spasm. The apical distribution of the left ventricle has the highest density of sympathetic nervous system fibres which may explain the characteristic regional wall dyskinesia. In at least one-third of cases, there is a degree of underlying left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) obstruction, which increases LV workload, worsening sympathetic nervous system activation and apical dyskinesis. These patients usually have more severe disease and a poorer prognosis

claims.text: 90% of cases occur in post-menopausal women, usually with sudden emotional stress; cases in men are more likely associated with physical stress
claims.quote: 90% of cases worldwide occur in post-menopausal women, usually associated with sudden emotional stress. Cases in men are more likely to be associated with physical stress

claims.text: Symptoms Ischaemic chest pain, ECG changes ± elevated cardiac enzymes, with normal coronary arteries on angiography
claims.quote: Produces ischaemic chest pain, ECG changes +/- elevated cardiac enzymes in patients with normal coronary arteries on angiography

claims.text: Treatment and next step Her chart: supportive; rule out CAD
No ECG criteria can safely differentiate it from STEMI in the ED; if in doubt, activate the local code STEMI protocol
claims.quote: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy is difficult to distinguish from STEMI in the ED, and no ECG criteria can be safely used to differentiate between the two conditions. If in doubt, you should activate your local code STEMI protocol

claims.text: Largely supportive; LV function usually returns spontaneously within 21 days of onset
claims.quote: Treatment is largely supportive, and LV function usually spontaneously returns within 21 days of onset

claims.text: Anticoagulate with large areas of cardiac hypokinesis (high risk of cerebrovascular thromboembolic events)
claims.quote: Anticoagulation should be initiated in patients with large areas of cardiac hypokinesis, as they are at high risk of cerebrovascular thromboembolic events

claims.text: Better prognosis than STEMI with a similar ECG, but not benign
claims.quote: Takotsubo has a better prognosis than STEMIs with a similar ECG but it is certainly not benign
